title: How AI agents actually work (in 5 images)
caption: Everyone says "AI agent." Almost nobody can draw one. Here's what's actually happening under the hood, in 5 images. Save this — it'll make every agent demo make sense.

promptVars.CONCEPT: An agent is a repeating loop, not a one-shot answer
promptVars.VISUAL: A bold circular loop of 4 connected nodes labeled PERCEIVE, PLAN, ACT, OBSERVE, arrows flowing clockwise, one node glowing brighter than the rest, clean geometric, cream background

promptVars.CONCEPT: Without memory the agent forgets you between every step
promptVars.VISUAL: A split image: left side a goldfish-simple single bubble fading out, right side a layered stack of glowing memory cards being carried forward along an arrow, clean isometric, cream background

promptVars.CONCEPT: The model only thinks — tools let it act in the real world
promptVars.VISUAL: A central brain-orb with clean lines extending out to 4 labeled tool icons: SEARCH, CODE, DATABASE, SEND, premium minimal icon set, soft shadows, cream background

promptVars.CONCEPT: A goal becomes a tree of sub-steps the agent must sequence
promptVars.VISUAL: A clean branching tree diagram: one top GOAL node splitting into ordered numbered sub-task nodes, the critical path highlighted in the accent color, gallery-grade, cream background

promptVars.CONCEPT: No way to check its own work means it fails silently in production
promptVars.VISUAL: A confident robot figure walking off a cliff edge with a blindfold, but rendered as a clean premium minimal pictogram, a single warning-accent guardrail missing, high-contrast, near-black background

slides.sub: The 5 patterns that ship in production. Free.
